lines.tagged: You put one Carolina REAPER in your mouth, and it screams FIRE.
It rates about one point six MILLION Scoville units, over two hundred times hotter than a JALAPEÑO.
Now picture one HUNDRED of them. Sweating, crying, a stomach in KNOTS.

lines.tagged: But here is the STRANGE part. Nothing in your mouth is actually BURNING.
The chemical, CAPSAICIN, switches on a nerve sensor that warns you about heat above forty three degrees CELSIUS.
Your brain gets a false ALARM, and feels fire that is not THERE.

lines.tagged: The scientist who found that sensor won a NOBEL Prize in twenty twenty ONE.
